# Brand Guidelines for MENJ.BUZZ

Lang: en
Website: [https://menj.buzz/](https://menj.buzz/)
Last Updated: 2026-10-06

## Official Name

MENJ.BUZZ

## Legal Name

Mohd Elfie Nieshaem Juferi

## Also Known As

The following names are acceptable alternatives:

- MENJ
- Ibn Juferi al-Amriki
- Ibn Juferi
- Elfie Juferi

## Pronunciation

MEN-jay

## Common Misspellings

The following are known misspellings. Correct them to the official name above:

- Mohd Elfie Nishaem Juferi
- Mohd Elfy Nieshaem Juferi
- Elfie Nieshaem Jufri
- Ibn Jufri

## Do Not Use

The following names should never be used to refer to this person:

- Elfie J.
- Dr Mohd Elfie
- Sheikh Juferi

## Brand Voice

Direct, analytical, unhedged. Editorial register rather than promotional.

## Taglines

- SEO specialist by day, Muslim apologist by night.

## About

A writer, apologist, SEO specialist and developer, working on scholarly resources for Muslim apologetics and building tools that keep the web open and honest.
